gt_usage: New fits use Head SE3 and cameras only, no GT shape. D is previous oracle-shape reference. GT shape and other joints only read in evaluation.
evaluation: Absolute camera-space errors without scale/rigid alignment. GT in-frame flags do not test visibility.
